text:
charu: Quick heads-up — I'm sketching a small RFC for routing overrides by customer tier+region. Goal: make per-tenant policies + clear fallback semantics and quota enforcement modes. Sharing rough sketch below, pls poke.

ben: sgtm, can you call out the expected semantics when multiple fallbacks exist? first-match or score-based?

charu: thinking first-match with explicit priority field, not score. keeps evaluation cheap at request time. Example: `priority: [preferred, cheaper, smallest]`. open to alternatives.

alyssa: prefer deterministic first-match for auditability. but need atomicity guarantees when quota flips mid-request (e.g., streaming tokens).

zach: +1. For streaming we should lock route selection at start of request and stick to it unless explicit `fallback_on_error` triggers mid-stream. Otherwise customers see model hop.

maria: what about quotas? soft vs hard? We have pro/free/enterprise tiers — need different behaviors. Proposal:
```
policy:
  enforcement: soft | hard | metered
  burst_tokens: int
  fallthrough: boolean
```
soft = allow fallback silently and log, hard = abort with 429, metered = route to cheaper and charge lower rate but still serve.

ben: metered sounds tricky for billing but valuable. Need telemetry events for billing classification. Also add `quota_reason` in traces.

ops-qa: Can we make telemetry names consistent with current tracing? Suggest: `routing.selection`, `routing.fallback`, `quota.enforcement` and include tags: `tenant_id`, `tier`, `region`, `route_priority`, `policy_id`.

charu: good call. I added a small sample config block for the console UI and internal API: 
```
{
  "tenant_id": "acme",
  "tier": "free",
  "region": "eu-west-1",
  "routes": [
    {"variant": "gpt-small-q4_0", "priority": 10, "quota_mode": "soft"},
    {"variant": "gpt-x8a", "priority": 20, "quota_mode": "hard"}
  ],
  "fallback_on_error": true
}
```
This is what the internal API would accept. Console should render effective policy and let admins reorder priorities.

alyssa: UI note — show an "effective route" preview with simulated token usage so admins can see when soft->hard transitions would happen. Otherwise they will be surprised.

zach: rollout plan: feature-flag per-tenant, start with 5 internal tenants, then opt-in beta, then gradual ramp. Add a warning banner when `quota_mode: hard` is set for free tier.

maria: need tests: unit for selector, integration test with streaming (simulate mid-stream quota hit), e2e to assert telemetry contains `quota_reason`.

ben: internal API question: should we allow policy inheritance (global -> tier -> tenant override) or only tenant-level explicit policies? I vote inheritance with clear override precedence to reduce config duplication.

charu: inheritance supported: precedence global < tier < tenant. Will include `effective_policy_id` in rendered UI and traces so we can debug.

deploy-bot: deploy-preview for branch routing-overrides available at https://staging-console.internal/commit/7d1a (canary toggle included).

ops-qa: one more: telemetry cardinality. Avoid free-form strings for variant names in metrics; use canonical variant IDs and map human names in UI only.

charu: noted. I'll update RFC with canonical IDs, telemetry schema, API JSON schema, sample console wireframes, and the rollout checklist. Thanks for quick feedback — I'll ping when I push the draft. :rocket:
